name: Karder Dal-Arouya
source: With Barlin's assistance, Karder managed to escape from prison. After making his way to the Tower of the Moon inn in Balay, he met with the former Magister of Secrets, who persuaded him to flee to Gaunteinguk, where Barlin's family wields significant influence, and proclaim himself the Khan.
